item.title: Welcome to the new EQUATOR Network website
item.dc:creator: UK EQUATOR Centre
item.description:
We are pleased to announce the launch of the redesigned EQUATOR Network website. The new site is designed to help researchers, authors, editors, peer reviewers and educators find the resources they need to improve the quality and transparency of health research reporting, faster than ever.

Since its founding, the EQUATOR Network has been a trusted source for reporting guidelines such as CONSORT, PRISMA and STROBE. As the library has grown, so has the need for a site that makes it simple to navigate. The new design puts users first, with clearer structure, improved search and a more modern look.

What’s new:

- Easier navigation: A faster way to search reporting guidelines and research reporting guidelines under development

- Refreshed toolkits authors, journals, peer reviewers and reporting guideline developers

- Improved look: a clean and modern feel to the website

Feedback

Tell us what you think via our contact page.

If you come across any deadlinks, also please let us know so we can fix them.
